claude_proposed_widenings.name: resource-less activated magic-item ability
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current activation family requires an ActivationResource and reset cadence, but Instant Fortress is command-word activated repeatedly with no uses, charges, or rest-based refresh.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "As a Magic action, you can place this 1-inch adamantine statuette on the ground and, using a command word, cause it to grow rapidly into a square adamantine tower. Repeating the command word causes the tower to revert to statuette form"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's main mechanic creates and later manipulates a persistent tower object. The current surface only supports self, target, area, and mark attachments for activation phases.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "cause it to grow rapidly into a square adamantine tower"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: create_object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The surface has alter_item_kind but no way to represent creation/deployment of a durable object into the play space. Instant Fortress is not just changing an existing item's cosmetic kind; it deploys a damageable tower with persistent state.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "cause it to grow rapidly into a square adamantine tower"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: activation precondition: attached object empty
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Reverting the fortress is conditional on the created tower being empty. Current activated abilities have no precondition grammar for conditional success based on attached-object occupancy/state.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Repeating the command word causes the tower to revert to statuette form, which works only if the tower is empty."

discrepancies: no content/magic_item_instant_fortress.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
